title: ARESHealthTelemetryPacket
description: Standardized biometric and environmental telemetry packet transmitted at 20 Hz from ares-engine (Safe Rust) to ares-cockpit (React / Three.js) and local MCP agents.

timestamp_ms.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds of sample acquisition.

mission_elapsed_days.description: Elapsed days since deep-space transit departure (Earth-Mars transit day 1 to 1000).

astronaut_id.description: Identifier of the crew member monitored.

heart_rate_bpm.description: Instantaneous heart rate in beats per minute.

hrv_rmssd_ms.description: Root mean square of successive differences for autonomic tone.

core_temp_celsius.description: Core body temperature (elevated in spaceflight-associated fever).

respiration_rate_brpm.description: Respiration rate in breaths per minute.

ijv_csa_cm2.description: Internal Jugular Vein Cross-Sectional Area in cm^2 (normal 0.8-1.5, deconditioned >2.5).

ijv_velocity_max_cm_s.description: Peak systolic/mean blood flow velocity in cm/s (stasis <5.0).

wall_shear_stress_dyn_cm2.description: Endothelial wall shear stress in dyn/cm^2 (normal 8-15, critical prothrombotic collapse <4.0).

thrombosis_risk_score.description: Virchow's Triad probability score computed by ADHG causal graph.

soleus_thickness_mm.description: Ultrasound soleus muscle thickness in mm (atrophy <11.0).

pennation_angle_deg.description: Fascicle pennation angle in degrees (loss of architectural force transmission <13.0).

bone_resorption_rate_pct.description: Monthly rate of trabecular bone mineral density loss.

mechanotransductive_index.description: Daily normalized strain stimulus from ARED exercise loading.

cabin_co2_ppm.description: Cabin carbon dioxide partial pressure in ppm.

cabin_o2_kpa.description: Cabin oxygen partial pressure in kPa.

ambient_radiation_rate_ugy_h.description: Instantaneous dosimeter reading in microGray per hour.

cumulative_radiation_mgy.description: Total mission accumulated ionizing radiation dose in milliGray.

med_stl_rho_robustness.description: Normalized Quantitative Satisfaction (NQS-STL) degree in (-inf, +1.0]. Positive is safe, negative is violated.

time_to_violation_days.description: Estimated remaining days before critical safety envelope violation.

mission_readiness_index.description: Composite score of EVA/landing physical readiness (0 to 100).

alarm_level.description: Automated alarm tier according to NASA flight medical rules.

playbook_id.description: Identifier of active clinical guideline, e.g. MEDOPS-PB-04-JUGULAR-STASIS.

total_steps.description: Total number of steps in active protocol.

step_instruction.description: Actionable medical instruction presented to crew.
